_comment: One entry per source. `file` is relative to backend/kb-data/ (git-ignored; do not commit raw videos or PDFs). Check each licence on the source's own page and record it in `license`. Example entry: { "id": "vid_cs50_w5", "subject_id": "dsa", "kind": "video", "title": "...", "provider": "...", "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>", "license": "...", "file": "cs50_w5.vtt" }
